messages:
elaine_cs: Heads up — DataPivot usage dropped ~64% starting Monday morning. I pulled the token-level dashboard and it's mainly generation requests down, embeddings steady. https://redwood.app/accounts/datapivot/usage :warning:
ben_ae: ugh. any known exec churn or procurement hold?
elaine_cs: Yep — heard from Jane (POC) that their CTO left last week and new interim CTO put a hold on vendor contracts while they do a technical audit. Procurement also asked for a competitive cost comparison.
marco_se: Do they have a pilot with anyone else?
elaine_cs: They're running a 6-week pilot with FastServe AI across two teams (search & summaries). Timeline started 10 days ago.
priya_renewals: Important: their renewal is in 9 weeks. This is time-sensitive. Can we get usage delta + quality metrics to show ROI ASAP?
elaine_cs: I exported a quick packet: usage trend + latency + 10 representative prompts where our answers match human evals. Link: s3://redwood-exports/datapivot/2167894321/packet.pdf
ben_ae: I'll reach out to Jane to request an intro to the interim CTO. Priya — can you join the call? Exec-level trust will help.
priya_renewals: Yep, I'll join. Also recommend offering a cost-sensitivity packet and a short canary: 100k free gen tokens for their pilot teams for 2 weeks to compare. Thoughts?
marco_se: Agree on canary — we can also flip on a higher-priority routing to reduce latency for their pilot routes for 72 hours. That would buy them a clean performance comparison.
kevin_head_cs: +1. Elaine, please set a short remediation plan with owners and timelines. Minimal ask: 1) Exec intro by EOW, 2) deliver ROI packet by tomorrow, 3) enable canary by Thu.
elaine_cs: Plan noted. Owners: Ben — CTO intro, Priya — contract/price playbook and renewal leash, Marco — perf canary config, me — ROI packet and user examples. I'll post an update after Ben's sync with Jane.
ops-bot: Audit log: canary quota 100000 tokens provisioned to datapivot-pilot on cluster-us-west at 2167894600
ben_ae: Reached out to Jane — she booked a 30m with Jane + interim CTO for Friday 11am PT. Added Priya and Elaine.
elaine_cs: Great. I'll attach the ROI packet in the calendar invite. Also capturing risks: competitor pilot shows faster initial demos but unclear cross-team scale; procurement explicitly asked for SSO audit and SOC2 evidence. Marco — can you surface SOC2 cert and a short ops checklist?
marco_se: Will do. I'll paste a one-page ops checklist and SOC2 link into the invite.
priya_renewals: If procurement pushes for a lower quote, we can propose a 3-month committed dedicated pool with rollout credits. I'll draft two pricing scenarios after I see the usage export.
elaine_cs: Thanks all — I'll update thread after the Friday call. Key metric we'll watch: Gen tokens/day returning to baseline within 2 weeks of canary.
kevin_head_cs: Good triage. If the call flags a real churn intent, escalate to AE manager and legal early.
elaine_cs: noted. closing loop for now, will post next steps post-call. :thumbsup:
